resources.name: Crystal structure data for Janus Y3-Cr2-X3 (space group P31m, No.157) and symmetric X3-Cr2-X3 (P-31m, No.162)

access.notes: Wyckoff positions and atom counts are provided in the instruction: for Janus, halogen atoms on 3c, Cr on 2b; for symmetric, I on 6k, Cr on 2c. Standard space group symmetry information is sufficient.

resources.name: Character tables for point groups C3v and D3d

access.notes: Character tables including basis functions are provided in the instruction as numeric arrays. They can be implemented directly in the solver's code.
